integrity.claim: Exact \(\operatorname{Cov}(A_i,F_j)\) matrix, odd/even rank, and aggregate consequences all pertain to one uniform permutation.
integrity.proof_basis: Conditional counting of ordered value pairs and an explicit left-nullspace computation; finite enumeration is corroboration only.
integrity.reproducibility: A standalone Python 3 verification script is included.

scientific_limitations: Uniform permutations only; exact +1 successions at adjacent positions; second-order covariance rather than a joint law. The result neither asserts independence for zero covariance nor priority beyond inspected sources. General refined enumeration may implicitly imply the formula.
title: A parity-sensitive cross-covariance law for unseparated pairs and fixed points
